title: Fix Frontend TypeScript Compilation Errors for Deployment

requirements.summary: Audit and fix all frontend TypeScript compilation errors to ensure the Vite build completes successfully
acceptanceCriteria: The Vite/TypeScript build completes with zero type errors
All frontend components import and use backend-derived types correctly
No missing or mismatched type declarations remain

file_operations.description: Review all type imports from frontend/src/backend.d.ts and ensure they match the backend interface. Verify that all query and mutation hooks return correctly typed data (e.g., Video, UserProfile, Comment, ConversationSummary, DirectMessage, etc.). Fix any mismatched or missing type references, incorrect return types, or undefined properties. Ensure all hook signatures align with component usage patterns observed in frontend/src/pages/*.tsx and frontend/src/components/*.tsx.

Verify that all Video type properties (id, title, thumbnail, hashtags, description, mediaUrl, likes, viewCount, timestamp, mediaType, category, uploader, comments, reactions) are correctly imported and used. Fix any type mismatches or missing properties when rendering video metadata, handling likes, or displaying comments. Ensure ExternalBlob usage for thumbnail and mediaUrl follows the backend interface definition.

Review the Video[] type returned by the useGetVideos query hook. Ensure the feed correctly handles the Video type structure, including all required fields (id, title, thumbnail, hashtags, description, mediaUrl, likes, viewCount, timestamp, mediaType, category, uploader, comments, reactions). Fix any type errors related to video rendering, filtering, or sorting.

Verify that UserProfile type imports and usage match the backend interface (id, bio, verified, username, badges, joinedAt, avatarUrl, savedVideos, avatar). Fix any type mismatches when displaying user profile data, handling avatar ExternalBlob, or managing badges. Ensure the profile editing flow correctly types the profile update payload.

Verify that Comment type (id, authorId, text, authorName, timestamp, videoId) is correctly imported and used when rendering comments. Fix any type mismatches in comment display, sorting, or submission. Ensure the addComment mutation correctly types the videoId and text parameters.

Verify that ConversationSummary type (lastMessage, otherUser, unreadCount) and DirectMessage type (id, text, isRead, toUser, timestamp, fromUser) are correctly imported and used. Fix any type mismatches when rendering conversations, displaying message previews, or handling unread counts.

Verify that DirectMessage type fields (id, text, isRead, toUser, timestamp, fromUser) are correctly typed and used when rendering the conversation view. Fix any type mismatches in message display, sending new messages, or marking messages as read.

Verify that UserProfile type is correctly typed when submitting the profile setup form via useSaveCallerUserProfile. Fix any type mismatches in the profile payload construction, especially for avatar ExternalBlob, username, bio, and other required fields.

Verify that UserProfile type is correctly typed when submitting profile updates via the updateProfile mutation. Fix any type mismatches in the profile payload, ensuring all required fields (id, bio, verified, username, badges, joinedAt, avatarUrl, savedVideos, avatar) are correctly structured.

Verify that ExternalBlob type is correctly used for video and thumbnail uploads. Ensure the createVideo mutation payload correctly types title, description, category, hashtags, video (ExternalBlob), thumbnail (ExternalBlob), and mediaType (Variant_video_photo enum). Fix any type mismatches or missing fields.
